verdict: 1,419 is an ENTRY-level parse count (loose entry-start rule) with no committed parser behind it: the committed re-parse yields 1517 raw entries and the printed OCR supports 1476 entry-like lines, so the reproducible statement is the band [1419, 1517] and 118/N = 7.78-8.32 %. The published TSV's 1118 edition rows are a clean-subset FLOOR, not the canon: 556 of 1476 entry lines carry an OCR-merged 'Siglum Title' token that the pass-2 filter discarded, so 118/1,118 = 10.55 % overstates coverage and must never be quoted as the declared canon.
